title: Overseas remittance firm Eninepay reportedly hacked, 25억원 taken, Etnews reports
date_note: Etnews' article of 27 November gives no earlier date for the hack; the date is the article's publication day.
summary: Etnews reports in an exclusive that Eninepay, described as South Korea's first small-amount overseas remittance company, was hacked and 25억원 of customer funds was taken. The article calls it the largest fund theft from a domestic hacking incident. It says, citing industry sources, that the Financial Supervisory Service is investigating how the breach happened.
plain: Etnews reports that a South Korean overseas remittance company, Eninepay, was hacked and 25억원 was taken. Industry sources say the financial regulator is investigating.
